signals.name: Rain in the last 24 hours
signals.explanation: A moderate rain can wash street dirt and oil into the creek. Worth watching for muddy water.

signals.name: Water level
signals.explanation: The creek is flowing about as usual for this time of year.

signals.name: Muddy-water reports
signals.explanation: Two people saw brown water recently, which can mean soil is washing in.

signals.name: Trash reports
signals.explanation: Trash was reported near Mill St. Trash can hurt wildlife and block flow.

signals.name: Algae reports
signals.explanation: Thick algae plus warm afternoons can lead to an algal bloom, which can be harmful to dogs and people.

signals.name: Air temperature
signals.explanation: Warm weather helps algae grow faster.

signals.name: Sewage smell
signals.explanation: Someone smelled sewage. That can mean a leak, so it is flagged for follow-up.

signals.name: Water level
signals.explanation: Low, slow water warms up faster and holds less oxygen for fish.
